events.title: Patrol scans a suspicious ship

participants.note: any trader-archetype hull works; smuggler makes the best story

events.arrangement: Patrol closes to 30 wu abeam of the subject on a matched-velocity parallel
events.startConditions: Existing patrol_scan encounter trigger; subject selected by role weight (smuggler > courier > hauler)
events.visibleCue: The patrol's metronome sweep STOPS - a lamp that has swept all day locking onto one hull is the loudest quiet signal in the code

phases.name: shadow
phases.visible: Patrol matches course one lane-width off, sweep still running

phases.name: lock
phases.visible: Sweep stops ON the subject (PAINT reaction geometry, blue); subject holds course too perfectly

phases.name: read
phases.visible: Both fly straight and parallel - the pause where paperwork happens; nearby traffic gives the pair one extra width

phases.name: release
phases.visible: Sweep resumes; patrol peels off in a visible quarter-turn - the all-clear everyone can read

events.completion: Both resume routes; the region watched the law work and nothing burned

interruptions.outcome: Chains into ev_smuggler_breaks (patrol pursues per existing intent-steering)

interruptions.trigger: Subject is clean courier and patrol is needed elsewhere (threat event)
interruptions.outcome: Lock aborts; patrol diverts - law has priorities

playerInterference: Fly between them and the lock transfers to YOU (you asked for it)
Attack the patrol mid-read - the subject bolts free regardless of guilt
events.criminalOpportunity: Every second the patrol spends reading one hull is a second the rest of the lane is unwatched - other events may key on scan-in-progress
events.aftermath: Scanned-clean subjects are exempt from re-scan for the session (the law remembers)
events.fallback: Subject despawns mid-lock: patrol sweeps once through empty space and resumes - unbothered
events.notes: The patrol_scan encounter trigger and PAINT reaction both exist; this formalizes the four-beat visible choreography around them.

events.title: Customs pulls a hauler aside

participants.note: wasp hull + authority accent until customs_cutter promoted

environment: lane with an off-lane inspection point 60 wu abeam
events.arrangement: Customs ahead-left of the hauler; both decelerate and translate to the inspection point; hauler holds nose-out
events.startConditions: Lawful-jurisdiction sector; hauler with manifest crosses the customs beat
events.visibleCue: Two hulls leaving the lane TOGETHER at matched speed, the front one steering the pair - unmistakably an escort-to-the-side, not a convoy

phases.name: flag_down
phases.visible: Customs takes the lead-abeam slot with the steady arc-blue bar lit (no honest trade carries that light)

phases.name: pull_aside
phases.visible: Pair translates off-lane in formation; lane traffic flows past them

phases.name: inspect
phases.visible: Hauler holds; customs flies ONE slow orbit around it, lock-lamp on the cargo spine the whole way - the walkaround made spatial

phases.name: wave_on
phases.visible: Customs breaks orbit and flashes the release; hauler spines up and rejoins the lane

events.completion: Hauler resumes with a session 'inspected' flag; customs returns to its beat

interruptions.outcome: Chains into ev_smuggler_breaks with customs as pursuer
Inspection aborts; hauler is waved on unexamined - a crime window the player can watch open

playerInterference: Get scanned yourself if you cross the orbit line
Rob the PARKED hauler while the law circles it (audacity has a market)
Kill the customs mid-orbit and the hauler flees - grateful or guilty, you never learn which
events.criminalOpportunity: The inspection point is fixed per beat: contraband movers learn to cross elsewhere - and so can the player
events.aftermath: Inspected flag; if inspection aborted, the hauler keeps a visible unexamined marker (scanner readout nuance)
events.fallback: Customs despawns mid-orbit: hauler waits one beat, then leaves - slightly too fast
events.diagramMermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Customs
  participant H as Hauler
  participant L as Lane traffic
  C->>H: takes lead-abeam, arc-blue bar lit
  C->>H: steers pair off-lane
  L-->>L: flows past, one width wider
  C->>C: one slow orbit, lock on cargo spine
  C->>H: release flash
  H->>H: spine_wake, rejoins lane

events.title: Patrol escorts a hazardous tanker

participants.note: mule + volatile manifest until donor promoted

events.arrangement: Tanker on lane center; patrol holds the borrowed-shadow slot ahead-flank, pin toward the CLIENT, guns toward the world
events.startConditions: Loaded tanker transits a lawful sector (escort flag on the traffic role pairing)
events.visibleCue: An escort formation around a hull that is visibly CARGO, not a VIP - mass with a bodyguard means the mass is dangerous

phases.name: join
phases.visible: Patrol slides into the flank slot; its pin lamp faces the tanker (the one Working-Light signal with no profile yet - drawn with the existing sweep lamp held steady)

phases.name: transit
phases.visible: Pair crosses the pocket; other traffic yields TWO widths instead of one - the deference measures the danger

phases.name: handoff
phases.visible: At the boundary the patrol breaks in a wide arc and returns to its ring; the tanker continues alone

events.completion: Tanker leaves the sector; patrol resumes its 4-beat ring

interruptions.outcome: Patrol interposes between threat and tanker (existing squad escort behavior); tanker holds course - it cannot maneuver anyway

playerInterference: Fly the second flank yourself and the patrol accepts the geometry (adjacency)
Bait the escort off with a distress flash, leaving the tanker naked (the classic two-crew job)
events.criminalOpportunity: The escort ADVERTISES the cargo's value; splitting the pair is the whole game
events.aftermath: Delivered volatiles blip the destination market
events.fallback: Patrol lost: tanker continues alone at reduced speed - visibly more careful
events.notes: Escort slotting exists (escorts:true) but is convoy-anchored - pairing an escort to a single cargo hull plus the doubled passive-avoid radius is a small addition, so this sits at the top of next20 rather than first15.

events.title: Smuggler breaks from inspection
environment: open pocket with at least one asteroid cluster for the break line
events.arrangement: Starts from ev_patrol_scans_suspect lock geometry; break vector through the nearest clutter
events.startConditions: Scan lock on a smuggler-flagged subject
events.visibleCue: The subject's too-perfect course wobbles once - the tell before the bolt - then the drive lights FULL

phases.name: bolt
phases.visible: Smuggler breaks 90 degrees through the clutter, burning hard; a clean_burn bar on a hull that motion says is HEAVY - the forgery visible in real time

phases.name: pursuit
phases.visible: Patrol pursues per existing intent-steering; the pair carves visible arcs through the rocks

phases.name: jettison
phases.visible: Smuggler dumps three cargo pickups in a spray to shed mass - and evidence

phases.name: resolve
phases.visible: Either the patrol breaks off to secure the jettison (cargo beats collar), or it runs the smuggler down (existing combat)

events.completion: Most runs end with the patrol loitering over the dumped cargo and the smuggler gone - the law got SOMETHING, the runner kept the hull

interruptions.outcome: Existing combat resolution; wreck + full cargo spill

playerInterference: Grab the jettisoned cargo before the patrol secures it (visible theft under a badge)
Body-block the smuggler's line for the patrol
Screen the smuggler from the patrol - you are now interesting to the law
events.criminalOpportunity: The jettison spray is free contraband IF you beat the patrol to it - a 15-second window with a witness
events.aftermath: Dumped pickups persist if unclaimed; the escaped smuggler role re-weights toward this sector's edges for the session
events.fallback: Patrol lost mid-chase: smuggler keeps the cargo and vanishes at the boundary - crime pays sometimes, visibly
events.notes: Jettison = pickups.spawn with inherited velocity; the chase is existing pursuit steering. The heavy-motion/clean-lamp contradiction needs no new tech - the signal layer already reads loaded from the phase graph, and a forged flag is one boolean.

events.title: Authorities cone off a lane segment
environment: 4 temporary marker props (lane_furniture ash pins / everyday_space_kit strobes as dressing)
events.arrangement: Two patrols hold at the segment's ends; markers drop in a rectangle around the closed span; traffic diverts one lane-width around it
events.startConditions: Aftermath hook from a debris/accident event on the lane, or scheduled sweep
events.visibleCue: A patrol PLACING objects - authority that stops to build something is rarer than authority that chases

phases.name: cone_off
phases.visible: Lead patrol drops four strobing markers in sequence, flying the rectangle

phases.name: divert
phases.visible: Through-traffic bends around the marked box in a visible bypass bulge; second patrol holds at the choke like a crossing guard

phases.name: clear
phases.visible: Markers collected in reverse order; traffic snaps back to lane center

events.completion: Lane restored; markers gone; whatever was inside the box (debris, wreck work) finished its business unbothered

interruptions.trigger: A patrol pulled away by combat
interruptions.outcome: Markers stay but the choke goes unmanned - traffic starts cutting the corner within seconds, visibly

playerInterference: Fly through the box (nothing physically stops you - one patrol paints you disapprovingly)
Steal a marker (it is a prop-pickup; petty crime at its pettiest)
events.criminalOpportunity: The diverted route squeezes all traffic through one predictable bend for two minutes - toll and ambush events can key on an active closure
events.aftermath: None (markers recovered) - unless a marker was stolen, which the patrol notes
events.fallback: Both patrols lost: markers persist unmanned until the session ends - an abandoned closure that keeps bending traffic is its own story
events.notes: The divert is the passive-avoidance radius applied to four static markers - no traffic-law system needed for the SPOT closure. A true sector-wide lane closure with rerouted spawns is future.laneClosure and lives in the blocked list (ev_lane_closure_full).

events.title: Patrol shift change at the beat corner
environment: patrol ring corner point (beat0..beat3 already exist)
events.arrangement: Off-going patrol holds at the corner; relief arrives from the station on a straight leg; 5 wu abeam pass
events.startConditions: Patrol job cycle timer expires while a relief spawn is available
events.visibleCue: TWO identical authority hulls in one place, neither hostile - the rarest formation in a quiet sector

phases.name: hold_short
phases.visible: Off-going patrol parks at its beat corner, sweep still running - the watch is never unmanned

phases.name: relief_inbound
phases.visible: Relief launches from the station (existing patrol_launch profile) and flies the leg out

phases.name: pass_the_pin
phases.visible: Slow abeam pass; the off-going sweep STOPS as the relief's STARTS - one continuous watch, two hulls

phases.name: stand_down
phases.visible: Old patrol flies home dark and fast - off duty reads different from on

events.completion: Relief walks the same 4-beat ring; the old hull docks

interruptions.outcome: Off-going patrol extends its shift - and its ring visibly widens with impatience (speed +10%)

playerInterference: Time crimes to the pass-the-pin moment: both sweeps are pointed at each other for eight seconds
Follow the off-duty hull home to find the barracks berth
events.criminalOpportunity: Shift change is the oldest hole in every guard schedule - this event TEACHES the player the beat's clock by showing it
events.aftermath: None; the ring continues under new management
events.fallback: Relief killed en route: off-going patrol re-arms its own cycle (double shift; the widened-ring tell persists)
events.notes: The patrol HOLD phase, the ring, and the station patrol_launch profile all exist - this is scheduling plus one lamp handshake.

events.title: Sector lane closed and traffic rerouted
environment: a full lane between two stations
events.arrangement: Closure spans the whole lane; ALL traffic re-routes onto the secondary lane, doubling its density
events.startConditions: Major incident aftermath (tanker burn, battlefield wreck) on the primary lane
events.visibleCue: The busy lane goes EMPTY while the quiet one doubles - the region's traffic map visibly redrawn

phases.name: close
phases.visible: Patrols sweep the lane clear, escorting stragglers off it

phases.name: reroute
phases.visible: Secondary lane runs at double density with visible congestion spacing

phases.name: reopen
phases.visible: Barriers lift; traffic redistributes over a minute

playerInterference: Run the empty closed lane (fastest path in the region, if you dare)
Work the congested secondary - targets every 20 wu
events.criminalOpportunity: Doubled density on the secondary is a toll operator's dream shift
events.aftermath: Traffic pattern memory for the session
events.blockedOn: future.laneClosure - traffic spawn/routing has no lane-graph concept to close; spot closures (ev_lane_spot_closure) cover the readable version until then
events.notes: Kept in the catalog because the SPOT closure event chains toward it and the incident aftermath hooks already name it.
